cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Listed PRC equity can theoretically be sold, but it is a large 13.81% retained stake, subject to market liquidity, PRC transfer/tax/friction and control-path uncertainty.
cash_breakdown.reason: Non-operating investment created by disposal of former associate; treated as monetisable only after a deep haircut.

cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially monetisable investment asset, not needed for day-to-day display manufacturing, but not cash-like.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: PRC private strategic equity, not held for trading and no near-term disposal path proven.
cash_breakdown.reason: Long-term strategic FVTPL investment; included only at residual value.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Unlisted limited partnership with underlying private investments; no control over operating, investing and financing decisions.
Listed bonds are graded speculative credit risk and mature in 2028-2029 after prior maturity extension.
cash_breakdown.reason: Financial asset, but credit-impaired and not short-term cash equivalent.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Small Hong Kong investment property fair value is disclosed, but disposal time, tax and transaction costs are uncertain.
cash_breakdown.reason: Non-core property can be monetised in principle.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Interest-bearing unsecured bank borrowings repayable within one year are deducted at 100%.
Capitalised lease liability is small and deducted at 100%; continuing lease economics are also reflected in profit quality.
Reserve roughly covers about two months of cash operating cost for a manufacturing business with 30-150 day customer credit periods and working capital volatility.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash needed to keep the display business operating.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Large PRC listed and private investment monetisation may face withholding tax, trading impact, FX and dividend/remittance friction not separately quantified by the annual report.

profit_quality.assessment: Reported FY2025 profit is not a usable cash earnings base because it is dominated by HK$3.247bn non-recurring associate disposal gain. The display segment moved from HK$54.956m profit in FY2024 to HK$1.492m loss in FY2025, while FY2025 operating cash flow was HK$14.518m and capex rose to about HK$151m. The main denominator is therefore a conservative HK$25m pre-haircut distributable cash profit and HK$7.5m after a 0.30 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Excluded HK$3.247bn gain on disposal and deemed disposal of Nantong Jianghai from sustainable profit.
Excluded FVTPL fair value loss/gain and associate share of results from ordinary display business cash profit.
Used FY2024-FY2025 cash flow evidence rather than the FY2025 reported net profit.
Deducted/allowed for a normal maintenance capex base around FY2024 capex of HK$45m and additional working-capital reinvestment need.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: FY2025 operating cash flow was HK$14.518m versus parent net profit HK$2,788.741m; FY2024 operating cash flow was HK$142.173m. FY2025 capex was about HK$151.0m, mainly AI compute related equipment.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Recent profit quality is weak for owner-distribution purposes: one-off disposal gain, display segment loss in FY2025, operating cash flow far below reported profit, and continuing AI-related reinvestment.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Reported profit cash conversion is not meaningful; FY2025 OCF/reported parent profit is only about 0.5% because profit is mainly disposal accounting gain.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: HK$45m is used as a normal maintenance reference from FY2024, while FY2025 capex of HK$151m includes growth/AI equipment.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Receivables increased HK$69.833m in FY2025 and trade credit periods are 30-150 days, so a working-capital reinvestment allowance is required.

limitations: Primary annual report actual period end is 2025-03-31, while the input period bucket is 2025-12-31.
Cash ownership and jurisdiction split are not disclosed enough to prove fast parent-level extraction.
Investment asset disposal tax, lock-up and latest market value were not independently verified.
Only two fiscal years of cash flow and capex were extracted from the annual report, so the sustainable cash profit denominator is conservative and low-confidence.
